## Change

Describe the farmer-visible behavior or shared contract changed. Link the issue.

## Verification

List commands/checks actually run and their outcomes. Include screenshots for visible UI changes and reviewed examples for calculation changes.

## Data and assumptions

Identify new sources, units, model/catalog versions, limitations, and whether fixture data is synthetic.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Relevant acceptance checks pass.
- [ ] Contracts, fixtures, and documentation match the change.
- [ ] No credentials or private farm data are committed.
- [ ] Relevant module owner reviewed scientific/design/API meaning.
